title: RFBench: A Simulator-Grounded Multimodal Benchmark for Passive RF Layout Design and Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2611.23410v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While multimodal language models can interpret diagrams and generate structured outputs, their capacity to connect passive radio-frequency (RF) design intent, layout geometry, and electromagnetic behavior remains largely untested. To address this gap, we introduce RFBench, a simulator-grounded dataset and benchmark for passive RF layout design and understanding. The dataset contains 10,000 two-port planar layouts simulated using ADS Momentum, with each layout represented by editable geometric primitives, a raster image, a 16x16 occupancy grid, complex S-parameters at 201 frequency points, a structural category, and an RF response label. Building on these aligned representations, we define seven tasks spanning specification-conditioned layout generation, representation translation, response prediction, simulator-based validation, design diagnosis and improvement, structural understanding, and response classification. translated_title: RFBench：一个基于仿真器的无源射频版图设计与理解多模态基准
translated_abstract: 尽管多模态语言模型能够解释图表并生成结构化输出，但它们将无源射频（RF）设计意图、版图几何结构与电磁行为相互关联的能力在很大程度上尚未得到检验。为填补这一空白，我们提出了RFBench，一个面向无源射频版图设计与理解的、基于仿真器的数据集与基准。该数据集包含10,000个使用ADS Momentum仿真的双端口平面版图，每个版图由可编辑的几何图元、光栅图像、16x16占用网格、201个频点上的复数S参数、结构类别以及射频响应标签来表示。基于这些对齐的表示，我们定义了七项任务，涵盖规格条件下的版图生成、表示转换、响应预测、基于仿真器的验证、设计诊断与改进、结构理解以及响应分类。大量的基线实验……
tldr: 该论文提出了RFBench——首个基于ADS Momentum仿真器的无源射频版图设计与理解多模态基准，包含10,000个带有多模态对齐表示的双端口平面版图和七项任务，用以系统评估多模态语言模型连接射频设计意图、版图几何与电磁行为的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces RFBench, a simulator-grounded multimodal benchmark for passive RF layout design and understanding, featuring 10,000 ADS Momentum-simulated two-port planar layouts with aligned multimodal representations and seven tasks to systematically evaluate multimodal language models' ability to connect RF design intent, layout geometry, and electromagnetic behavior.
